title: The Core Analysis Brief
summary: Analyse is now the heart of YTIntel: one YouTube link runs the ordered 17-part Monday Brief, shows real parallel task progress, banks the research into a creator-specific vault and exports the result.
discord_changes: One video link now builds the full 17-section Monday Brief — from facts and hooks to frames, packaging, remake and transcript.
The Analysis Room now shows real parallel task progress while storyboard keyframes cover the full runtime instead of just replay peaks.
Creator niche, subniche, audience and brand rules now feed a persistent analysis/hook/package vault with side-by-side comparisons.
changes: Rebuilt Analyse around the exact Monday Brief order: Strip, Summary, Takeaways, Hook, Re-hooks, Payoffs, Most Replayed, Steal/Do Not Copy, Visuals, Motion, Audio, Packaging, Channel Context, Make It Yours, Vault, Cross-check/Export and Full Transcript.
Added a visible Analysis Room whose percentage only moves as real parallel evidence tasks resolve; it shows task telemetry rather than private model reasoning.
Added de-duplicated overall and per-minute WPM, longest-silence detection, transcript-wide beat sampling and source-backed hook/re-hook/payoff receipts.
Added public storyboard keyframes sampled across the full runtime plus replay-peak frames, honest storyboard visual-change cut/motion proxies and caption-coded music/SFX evidence.
Added thumbnail pixel measurements, possible title-test detection against the channel feed, title/hook keyword extraction and promise-versus-delivery checks.
Added channel-context scanning for recent channel-relative hits and same/adjacent title angles.
Added creator profile fields for niche, subniche, target audience and brand rules so Make It Yours can stay user-specific.
Added brand-rule-aware source-specific remake directions through the existing deep Packaging path; when cloud deep reasoning is unavailable, generic filler remains refused.
Added persistent analysis vault, hook bank and package bank tables with row-level security and local signed-out fallback storage.
Added a dedicated Vault UI with recent analyses, hook-bank and package-bank views plus two-item side-by-side comparisons.
Added deterministic timestamp/quote/metric cross-checks, full Markdown export, print/save-PDF support and full transcript copy/download.
Focused the visible product around Analyse, Competitors and Vault while retiring redundant top-level tools now incorporated into the Core Analysis Brief.
Expanded full-backup coverage to include the v0.30 profile, analysis vault, hook bank and package bank local stores.
Added focused v0.30 CI plus a production Chromium smoke test that requires all 17 sections, a 100% analysis-room completion state and a plausible-or-withheld WPM value.
Bumped the PWA shell and dynamic late-layer loader to v0.30.0.
why_it_matters: The core promise in the brief is now the product flow: hand YTIntel one video and get a source-grounded research artifact designed to replace manually watching and dissecting it, while missing replay/media/model evidence is labelled instead of invented.
